goal:
Assign work to relevant agents
1. Navigate to the Service Desk > Incidents. 

2. You have to assign the following incidents to relevant agents: WAM0133125, WAM0133957, WAM0133514, WAM0133784, WAM0133134. You can filter the list using each incident number and use the 'Assigned to' field to assign an incident.

3. You have to ensure that each incident is assigned to a relevant agent based on the category of the incident.

The category wise agents are as follows. You can assign an incident to ANY agent from the category:
Database agents: Billy-Kaylee Lin-Meadows, Michael-Dorothy Chapman-Vance 
Network agents: Tara-Nathan Tate-Douglas, Angela-Matthew Bush-Adams 
Software agents: Darryl-Alexandria Williams-Avila, Tristan-Jessica Robinson-Mills
